name: io.github.gamaze-labs/hicortex
title: Hicortex
description: Shared fleet memory for AI agents: nightly self-correction, recall every prompt (supported agents).

environmentVariables.name: HICORTEX_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for a remote Hicortex server (server prints it via `hicortex status`). Optional — a local server needs no token.

environmentVariables.name: HICORTEX_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of a remote Hicortex server (e.g. https://your-server:8787). Optional — omit for a local server on this machine.
